rows.docSource: description.md L42-52 '구조, 논리, 어휘, 문법, 주제 적합성을 세부 평가... 평가 항목 5개 이하, 각 항목 본문 2줄'; functional-spec.md L43 feedback_dimension_scores(dimension, score, score_max, summary, weakness_level); screen-data-summary.md L36 확정 계약 'feedback_dimension_scores...가 normalized detail을 제공한다'

rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L24 '개선 포인트'; description.md L52 '추천 없음/항목 누락은 빈 상태와 보완 안내'; functional-spec.md L43 feedback_dimension_scores(weakness_level)

rows.screenRequirement: 문장별 첨삭 — 문장 단위 원문/수정/코멘트, sentence_index 정렬, 5개 후 더보기 (Area 2)
rows.docSource: description.md L32-40 '문장 단위 첨삭, 수정 제안... 문장별 첨삭 5개 후 더보기'; functional-spec.md L44 sentence_feedback(sentence_index, original_text, corrected_text, comment); screen-data-summary.md L72 검수 '문장별 피드백 정렬 기준을 sentence_index로 고정'
rows.rationale: Per-sentence normalized table with typed sentence_index (stable ORDER BY per the 검수 item) + original/corrected/comment text. '5개 후 더보기' is pagination over rows. Fully satisfied.

rows.screenRequirement: 첨삭 생성 실패 문장 처리 — 실패 문장은 원문만 표시 + 재분석 (Area 2 예외)

rows.rationale: Failed sentence = a sentence_feedback row with NULL corrected_text/comment but populated original_text (all three are nullable in LIVE schema). The 원문만 표시 fallback and 재분석 CTA are client-derived from the null state; no new column. strong on render logic, but column nullability already supports it → satisfied.

rows.docSource: description.md L60-64 '비교 리포트... 액션', L87 '비교 리포트는 R-01'; screen-data-summary.md L37 확정 계약 'comparison_reports와 create_comparison_report_with_metrics RPC로 이전 제출 대비 리포트를 만들 수 있다 ... 현재 제출 id를 current_submission_id로 사용한다'

Current submission id = route :id = current_submission_id. Confirmed (RPC body read).

rows.screenRequirement: 비교 리포트 생성 버튼 조건 — 이전 제출이 있어야 활성 (검수 필요)
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L73 검수 '비교 리포트 생성 버튼의 조건을 정한다'; LIVE comparison_reports.previous_submission_id NULL allowed
rows.rationale: Enabling the compare CTA requires querying whether a prior same-problem/same-question submission exists. writing_submissions.parent_submission_id (self-FK) + user_id + question_no support that lookup with typed columns. The exact button condition is still a 검수 필요 open item (rule), but no schema gap — strong-inference because the precise predicate is undocumented, data is present.

rows.screenRequirement: 보관함 저장 — 피드백/제출을 보관함에 저장 (Area 4 저장)

rows.screenRequirement: PDF 내보내기 — 피드백을 PDF로 저장, 상태/실패/권한 잠금 처리 (Area 4 PDF 저장 → F-M1)

'failed' status drives the PDF 실패 토스트. Storage path exports/{user_id}/{export_id}.pdf is operational (screen-data-summary L50). Satisfied.

rows.screenRequirement: 다음 문제 추천 액션 — 추천으로 R-02 이동 (Area 4 다음 문제 추천)
rows.docSource: description.md L60 '다음 문제 추천', L87 '다음 문제 추천은 R-02', L78 '추천 학습'; functional-spec.md L18
rows.liveDbObject: (missing — out of E-02 scope; R-02 owns recommendation_runs/items)
rows.rationale: On E-02 this is a navigation CTA to R-02; recommendation generation/persistence (recommendation_runs/recommendation_items, source_type 'feedback') belongs to the R-02 screen, not this read screen. E-02 needs no recommendation column itself, so (missing) is intentional and satisfied (no data dependency on this screen). NOT a schema gap.

rows.screenRequirement: 장문 첨삭 운영 템플릿 — 개선 포인트 라벨, 문장 수정 유형, 채점 기준 문구를 운영 데이터로 관리
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md L38 '스키마 보강 필요: 개선 포인트 라벨, 문장 수정 유형, 채점 기준 문구를 운영 데이터로 관리하는 구조는 없다' (메모: '현재는 feedback 결과 데이터 중심이다')
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL + STABLE-QUERY: although LABELED '스키마 보강 필요', the 메모 says '현재는 feedback 결과 데이터 중심' — the screen RENDERS labels/types/criteria phrasing that arrive inside the per-result feedback rows (dimension.summary, sentence.comment) and the raw_ai_result jsonb blob. description.md states NO concrete query/validation need for a separate template-catalog table; it only displays evaluation text. Per the rule this stays jsonb/result-covered with stableQueryNeed=false. The template-catalog desire is a documented future-stabilization wish (operational template management), NOT a confirmed E-02 render gap. It is also content-authoring/operational tooling — if ever built it would be an admin/content-management concern, so do not invent a user-facing column.

rows.screenRequirement: RLS 소유자 경계 — 본인 제출/피드백/리포트/export만 조회 (권한 없음 상태)
rows.docSource: functional-spec.md L10 'auth.uid() 기반 RLS'; L51 '제출 소유자 RLS와 feedback_status를 함께 확인'; screen-data-summary.md L56-66 RLS 기준; functional-spec.md L31 '권한 없음'
rows.liveDbObject: writing_submissions.user_id / writing_feedback.user_id / feedback_dimension_scores.user_id / sentence_feedback.user_id / comparison_reports.user_id / library_items.user_id / export_files.user_id
rows.rationale: Every consumed table carries user_id FK -> profiles.id with owner-only RLS (writing_submissions select-only/immutable; feedback tables select-only with server-side create). The '권한 없음' state is enforced by RLS denying non-owner rows. All ownership columns present in LIVE schema.

jsonMapping.meaning: E-02 has NO sample/seed JSON. It is a read-mostly feedback DISPLAY screen consuming rows generated at submit time (RPC submit_writing_with_feedback for D-03/D-04). There is no source JSON file and therefore no JSON item id to preserve as seed provenance for this screen. Seed provenance for the underlying problem/answer content lives on the producing screens (D-03 sample-53.json item.id, D-04 sample-54.json item.id), not here.

frozenIslandNote: No admin codes (H-01/X-08/X-10/X-15) and no frozen objects (organizations, org_members, assignments, assignment_submissions, admin_*/get_admin_*) touched. All rows resolve to user-facing writing_submissions/writing_feedback/feedback_dimension_scores/sentence_feedback/comparison_reports/library_items/export_files/study_events + the user-scoped RPC create_comparison_report_with_metrics.
idempotencyNote: READ-ONLY conformance run — no migration or seed is applied. E-02 produces no seed of its own (no sample JSON). Any future feedback rows are written by the submit RPC keyed on the deterministic submission id, never by array index; this matrix proposes no new objects. No drop/reset/truncate.
overallVerdict: All confirmed E-02 screen data requirements are SATISFIED by the LIVE schema (writing_submissions, writing_feedback, feedback_dimension_scores, sentence_feedback, comparison_reports + create_comparison_report_with_metrics RPC, library_items, export_files, study_events). The single documented '스키마 보강 필요' item (장문 첨삭 운영 템플릿 — 라벨/수정 유형/채점 기준 문구 운영 관리) stays jsonb/result-covered with stableQueryNeed=false per CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL: the 메모 accepts the current result-data-centric model and description.md states no concrete typed-column query/validation need; it is a future operational/content-authoring wish, not a user-facing render gap. No schema-gap, no unresolved escalation, no frozen-island contact.
